subject: maths
question:
What annual instalment (in ₹) will discharge a debt of ₹9,429 due in three years at 12.25% simple interest per annum?

[Note: Instalments will be paid at the end of Year 1, Year 2 and Year 3.]
solution:
**Given:**

The annual installment will discharge a debt of 9,429 due in 3 years at 12.25 % simple interest.

**Formula used:**

Annual installment = dfrac{{100P}}{{100T + RTdfrac{(T - 1)}{2} }} 

(Where, P = Principal, R = Rate, T = Time )

**Calculation:**

According to question,

P = 9,429 

R = 12.25 %

T = 3 years

⇒Annual Installment = (100 times 9429)/(100times 3 + 12.25 times 3times frac{(3 - 1)){2}}

⇒Annual Installment = (942900)/(300 + 12.25 times 3times 1)

⇒Annual Installment = (942900)/(300 + 36.75)

⇒Annual Installment = ( 942900)/(336.75)

⇒Annual Installment = 2800

**∴ The answer is 2800.**
